mapper.insert: INSERT INTO subcontractors (name, contact_person, phone, address, qualification_level, credit_rating, business_scope, tax_identification_number, bank_account, description, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{contactPerson}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{qualificationLevel}, #{creditRating}, #{businessScope}, #{taxIdentificationNumber}, #{bankAccount}, #{description}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE subcontractors SET name = #{name}, contact_person = #{contactPerson}, phone = #{phone}, address = #{address}, qualification_level = #{qualificationLevel}, credit_rating = #{creditRating}, business_scope = #{businessScope}, tax_identification_number = #{taxIdentificationNumber}, bank_account = #{bankAccount}, description = #{description}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO subcontractor_project (subcontractor_id, project_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{subcontractorId}, #{projectId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM subcontractor_project WHERE subcontractor_id = #{subcontractorId} AND project_id = #{projectId}
